Prey & Predator

An ecosystem model where prey eat vegetation and predators hunt prey. Energy, reproduction, and movement shape the changing populations.

The original GAMA model includes adjustable parameters, population charts, and an optimization experiment. This browser version demonstrates the main agent interactions.
